CalPERS: the source is CalPERS's 13F-HR/A (restatement) for the quarter ended December 31, 2024, filed April 23, 2025; its information table is identical to the original 13F-HR filed February 12, 2025. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. CalPERS: CalPERS holds the listed Class B; denominator is Class A plus Class B. Holders of record: Listed Class B only; Class A has 16 holders of record.
